g.text: A first-order step reaches 63.2% of its final change in one time constant

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Zero initial deviation and a unit step. For t≥θ, y=K[1−exp(−(t−θ)/τ)], and y=0 before θ. Gain multiplies final step size; dead time shifts the response
without changing the time constant. These are ideal LTI models.
